messages:
Lina: Quickheads-up  I'm doing a micro-refresh of the 'Hello Quickstart' aiming to standardize auth env var and tighten the deploy checklist. I'll open a WIP PR with snippets.

Marco: ++ Please remove the legacy pip extras line (it confuses users). Also let's prefer REDWOOD_KEY as the env var.

Lina: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1012 (WIP). Replaced REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY, added a one-line Docker run example, trimmed lengthy token notes.

Taylor: Paste the Python snippet so I can smoke-test locally.

Lina: Here it is:
```
from redwood import Client
import os

client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp = client.generate("Hello from Redwood")
print(resp.text)
```

Marco: Nice. Add a PowerShell env var example: $env:REDWOOD_KEY = "sk-..." and a short note that setx persists across shells.

Lina: Added both, and shortened the container example to one command to avoid linter failures.

ci-bot: build failed  docs-lint: line-length (quickstart.md:44)

Taylor: I'll run the formatter and push a fix.

Taylor: Pushed wrap fixes and removed an outdated link to the old auth page.

docs-bot: Preview available: https://deploy-preview-1012--docs.redwood.com/quickstart

Lina: Preview looks good. @Marco can you give the deploy wording a quick pass? I shortened steps into a three-item checklist.

Marco: Reviewed. Suggested minor wording change ("push to prod" -> "deploy to prod") and added a bullet to verify API key scopes.

Lina: Incorporated and force-pushed.

ci-bot: All checks passed  ready to merge.

Lina: Merged. Created follow-up issue to add a migration note for teams using the old env var and a redirect.

Marco: Thanks! Also can we add a one-line blurb on the Upgrade Notes page? I'll pick that up in the next sweep.

Lina: Sounds good  closing this thread. :tada:
